title: What do I use?

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body: World edit would work! Just do, .//replace (blocks id), (other blocks id)

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Yes, there is a way to rotate it.
First, copy it and paste it in the area where you want it to be.
Then, use the command //rotate to rotate it 180 degrees.
I'm not exactly sure of the correct syntax, but if you look it up on the internet or YouTube, you will find some tutorials that show how it is done.
To switch the colours, do what Slicorn said, but make sure you have the area selected.
